title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 226 North Main Street in Roseville, Ohio, as the Ronald E. Rosser Post Office.
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 226 North Main Street in Roseville, Ohio, as the Ronald E. Rosser Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named the post office at 226 North Main Street in Roseville, Ohio, after Ronald E. Rosser.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building in Roseville, Ohio, at 226 North Main Street, as the Ronald E. Rosser Post Office. It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the name change took effect on that date.
